title: How To Find Rodent Entry Points Fast & Seal Them For Good
description:
🐭🔎  How To Find Rodent Entry Points Fast ⁉️ 

🏡 Rodent Entry Points in Residential Homes! 🐁 Entry Points Where Rats & Mice Get In Your Home! @pestproplus  Rodent Expert points our 5 areas in your home that need protection from rodents, we also discuss the exterior areas of the house most prone to entry points and the behaviours of mice 🐭 

➡️   Click Here to Get Your Rodent Prevention Calendar 🔗 https://pestprotectionplus.com/resources/seasonal-home-pest-prevention-calendars/

🐭🔎  How To Find Rodent Entry Points Fast ⁉️ 

As seasons shift in Southern Ontario, rodents actively seek indoor refuge, making proactive home sealing crucial, especially given the region's abundant nature and older housing stock. Pest Protection Plus highlights five key entry points to fortify against these unwanted guests, as ignoring them can lead to property damage and health risks. Your first line of defence is weatherstripping around all doors, including the garage, and windows; regularly inspect for damage and replace with durable, rodent-resistant materials, even considering metal door sweeps for added protection. Windows and doors themselves, particularly unsealed frames common in older homes, require attention; seal gaps with high-quality silicone caulk or rodent-proof expanding foam, check screens, and inspect basement windows closely. Utility lines also serve as pathways, with waterline entry points into foundations or walls needing waterproof sealant or expanding foam, potentially with a steel wool backing for larger gaps. Similarly, gas line entry points demand fire-resistant sealant or expanding foam, again with steel wool as a pre-sealant (always consult a professional for gas line concerns). Finally, AC line penetrations are common access areas, requiring durable, weatherproof sealant flexible enough for movement, and replacement of any damaged grommets. Sealing these five key areas, combined with regular inspections and maintenance, is a vital step in enjoying a pest-free Southern Ontario home; contact Pest Protection Plus for expert advice and tailored rodent control solutions.

title: Why are cockroaches so hard to kill? - Ameya Gondhalekar
description:
Dig into the genetic adaptations of cockroaches, and find out what makes it so hard to get rid of these tenacious creatures.

--

In ancient Egypt, there was a spell that declared, “Be far from me, O vile cockroach.” Thousands of years later, we’re still trying to oust these insects. But from poison traps to brandished slippers, cockroaches seem to weather just about everything we throw at them. So, what makes cockroaches so hard to kill? Ameya Gondhalekar digs into the genetic wonders of this troublingly tenacious creature.

Lesson by Ameya Gondhalekar, directed by Irida Zhonga.

In order to visualize and dramatize the lives of these fascinating creatures, the artists have chosen to playfully anthropomorphize cockroaches. In real life cockroaches don’t dine like humans, go shopping for organic matter, and most unfortunately, don’t wear lederhosen (at least, to the best of our knowledge).
